info.title: Admin Partner API
info.description:
**Admin Public API**

This API allows to integrate with Admin portal programmatically.

### Authentication
All endpoints are secured using **Bearer token authentication**.

Include the token in the request header:
`Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>`

### How to generate an API key
API keys can be generated from the admin portal:

**Settings → API Keys**

Admin URL:
/app/management/settings/ApiKeys

### Notes
- The same key can be used across multiple integrations.

### Error responses
Controller and validation errors return a **Response** object (`application/json`):
`{ "error": true, "message": "..." }`

A missing or invalid Bearer token rejected by the security filter returns a **SpringError** object (`application/json`):
`{ "timestamp": "...", "status": 401, "error": "Unauthorized", "message": "Unauthorized", "path": "..." }`

Endpoints protected by permission checks may return either shape for HTTP 401, depending on whether authentication failed or the authenticated user lacks permissions.

put.description: Partially updates a campaign payout rule. payoutId is the identity field from GET /{campaignId}/payout. Send only the fields you want to change; re-sending current values can overwrite a newer change. Omit a JSON field to leave it unchanged — affiliates, countries, tiers, catalogs, MLM, and schedule are preserved unless you send a replacement. Sending symbols or symbolGroups (including empty arrays) replaces all symbol overrides; omit both to keep them. When changing payoutType to Personal, send affiliateIds. When changing paymentType to CPA_QUALIFICATION on a rule that has no qualification, send qualification. Type-specific required fields still apply after the merge (REV_SHARE → revshareType, HYBRID → secondary commissions, CPA_QUALIFICATION → qualification). Advanced options remain UI-only.

Partial update: omit a field to keep it. `levels` is the exception: when sent, it replaces the whole list (send [] to switch MLM off). IMPORTANT: a level you leave out of `levels` is REMOVED (turned off). To change one level, first GET the settings and send back every level you want to keep, including the unchanged ones. Example: current levels are [1→5, 2→3]; to set level 1 to 10 send [{level:1, value:10}, {level:2, value:3}]. Sending only [{level:1, value:10}] would turn level 2 off. Omit `levels` entirely to leave all levels unchanged. The body is validated as a whole after merging with the current values, and the response is the saved settings. A GET response can be sent back as-is. Under SPLIT_COMMISSION the payout may not have more levels than the campaign override, or than the company when the campaign inherits.

MlmSettings.title: MLM Settings

customEnabled.description: Not used on the COMPANY tier (always null there). true = this campaign / payout / affiliate overrides the inherited MLM settings with the values in this object. false = it inherits; the other fields in a GET response then show the inherited values (see inheritedFrom). On PUT: send true to start overriding, false to disable the override and inherit again (all other fields in the request are then ignored; the override values stay stored). When true turns on an override for the first time, omitted fields are copied from the inherited values; when it re-enables a disabled override, omitted fields keep the values it had before it was disabled. Sending settings fields to a tier that inherits without customEnabled=true is rejected with 400.

For AFFILIATE this is the company default; during settlement a payout or campaign override still takes precedence over it. Allowed values: COMPANY, CAMPAIGN, PAYOUT, AFFILIATE.

type.description:
How each level's value is turned into a commission:
- COMMISSION_BASED: value is a percent of the converting affiliate's commission, paid on top.
- AMOUNT_BASED: value is a percent of the conversion amount, paid on top.
- RELATIVE_COMMISSION: value is a percent of the previous level's MLM commission.
- FIXED_COMMISSION: value is a fixed amount paid per conversion.
- SPLIT_COMMISSION: value is cut out of the converting affiliate's own commission instead of paid on top (see splitMode and splitUnit).
Settlement treats an unset type as COMMISSION_BASED, so GET shows COMMISSION_BASED then. When the company type is SPLIT_COMMISSION every other tier must be SPLIT_COMMISSION too (omit it and it is set automatically). Allowed values: COMMISSION_BASED, FIXED_COMMISSION, AMOUNT_BASED, RELATIVE_COMMISSION, SPLIT_COMMISSION.

splitMode.description:
COMPANY, CAMPAIGN and PAYOUT tiers (always null on AFFILIATE). Only used when type is SPLIT_COMMISSION. The company value applies to every conversion unless the campaign or payout that owns the levels sets its own; null on a campaign or payout means it follows the company. A PUT cannot set it back to null (null means unchanged): send the company's value, or customEnabled=false to inherit everything.
- DIRECT: only the direct parent (level 1) takes a cut. Levels 2-10 are not allowed.
- MULTI_LEVEL_OVERRIDE: chained from the converter up; level N's value is the percent the level-N upline takes from what the upline below it holds.
- WATERFALL: root-anchored; level 1 is the topmost upline's cut of the pool, level 2 the next one down, and the converting affiliate keeps the remainder.
Reset to DIRECT (null on campaign and payout) when type is not SPLIT_COMMISSION. Allowed values: DIRECT, MULTI_LEVEL_OVERRIDE, WATERFALL.

splitUnit.description: Only used when type is SPLIT_COMMISSION. PERCENT: level values are percents (0-100). PER_LOT: level values are an amount per traded lot (Forex), capped by the commission pool. Reset to PERCENT when type is not SPLIT_COMMISSION. Allowed values: PERCENT, PER_LOT.

ibSharingEnabled.description: COMPANY and AFFILIATE tiers only (null on CAMPAIGN and PAYOUT). Master Affiliate (IB sharing): lets a parent give each direct child a custom split (see /affiliates/{affiliateId}/ib-sharing). Requires type SPLIT_COMMISSION. On the AFFILIATE tier with customEnabled=true it overrides the company value for that affiliate only.

maxSharingPercent.description: COMPANY and AFFILIATE tiers only. Optional cap, a percent 0-100, for the custom splits a Master Affiliate sets in percent. With splitUnit PERCENT and ibSharingEnabled true the level 1 value must not exceed it. Omit to leave unchanged; it cannot be cleared through the API once set.

maxSharingPerLot.description: COMPANY and AFFILIATE tiers only. Optional cap, an amount per lot, for the custom splits a Master Affiliate sets per lot. With splitUnit PER_LOT and ibSharingEnabled true the level 1 value must not exceed it. Omit to leave unchanged; it cannot be cleared through the API once set.

companyLevelCustomIbSharingEnabled.description: COMPANY tier only. Lets managers set a custom split for any parent/child pair via /affiliates/{affiliateId}/ib-sharing even when Master Affiliate is off for that parent.

levels.description:
The active MLM levels. A level not in the list is off. Level 1 is the direct parent of the converting affiliate, up to level 10. Each level may appear once and needs a value >= 0.
- Percent types (COMMISSION_BASED, AMOUNT_BASED, RELATIVE_COMMISSION, SPLIT_COMMISSION with PERCENT): value 0-100.
- FIXED_COMMISSION and SPLIT_COMMISSION with PER_LOT: value is an amount, no upper limit.
SPLIT_COMMISSION rules: levels must be consecutive from 1 (1,2,3 — not 1,3); with splitMode DIRECT only level 1 is allowed; on the AFFILIATE tier only level 1 is allowed (it is that affiliate's own cut, deeper levels always come from payout / campaign / company).
On PUT the list replaces the current one. IMPORTANT: a level you leave out of `levels` is REMOVED (turned off). To change one level, first GET the settings and send back every level you want to keep, including the unchanged ones. Example: current levels are [1→5, 2→3]; to set level 1 to 10 send [{level:1, value:10}, {level:2, value:3}]. Sending only [{level:1, value:10}] would turn level 2 off. Omit `levels` entirely to leave all levels unchanged. Send [] to switch MLM off on this tier.

MlmSettings.description:
MLM (multi-level / referral) commission settings for one tier.

**Tiers and precedence.** MLM settings exist on four tiers: COMPANY (the default), CAMPAIGN, PAYOUT (one campaign payout rule) and AFFILIATE (an affiliate's own settings, used when that affiliate is the upline who earns). When a conversion is settled, each upline's settings are taken from the first tier that has customEnabled=true, in this order: the upline AFFILIATE, then the conversion's PAYOUT, then its CAMPAIGN, then COMPANY.

**Upline chain.** Every affiliate has at most one parent (see PUT /affiliates/{affiliateId}/parent). Level 1 is the converting affiliate's direct parent, level 2 is the parent's parent, up to level 10.

**PUT semantics.** Omit a field (or send null) to leave it unchanged. `levels` is the exception: when sent, it replaces the whole list. IMPORTANT: a level you leave out of `levels` is REMOVED (turned off). To change one level, first GET the settings and send back every level you want to keep, including the unchanged ones. Example: current levels are [1→5, 2→3]; to set level 1 to 10 send [{level:1, value:10}, {level:2, value:3}]. Sending only [{level:1, value:10}] would turn level 2 off. Omit `levels` entirely to leave all levels unchanged. Send `levels: []` to switch MLM off on this tier. `inheritedFrom` is read-only and ignored on PUT.

**Fields that only apply to SPLIT_COMMISSION** (splitUnit PER_LOT, splitMode other than DIRECT, ibSharingEnabled=true) are reset to PERCENT / DIRECT (null on campaign and payout) / false when type is not SPLIT_COMMISSION.Sending them explicitly together with another type is rejected with 400.
